The perf work is merged to `michael/dev`. The page-level changes, including the data-grid handoff, are still unverified (see the end).

- **Batching:** The only slow way to update rows is reading layout inside the write loop. For 1,000 rows (5,000 cells, three writes each) that took 6.8 s and 15,001 layouts, against about 70 ms for a plain loop. Your clone-swap idea measured no better than the plain loop (77 ms), and detach, hide and fragment tricks were no better either. The one helper that wins slightly is `Batch.js`, which keeps only the last write per key and paints once per frame (55 ms).
